def_en: 1) to quiver, totter, shake, reel, stagger, wander, move, sift, make move, wave, waver, tremble
1a1) to wave, quiver, vibrate, swing, stagger, tremble, be unstable
1b) (Niphal) to be tossed about or around
kjv: continually, fugitive, [idiom] make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).
expl: to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined)
